description: A freelance photographer must decide whether to accept a barter proposal for a portrait session, weighing the proposed exchange against another cash opportunity and verifying the item offered in trade.

shared_context.S1: Elena has one Saturday morning available for an informal portrait booking in June.
shared_context.S2: Marcus has asked whether Elena would trade a portrait session for a vintage audio component.
shared_context.S3: Elena is also considering other ways to use that Saturday booking slot.
shared_context.S4: Before Elena makes the final call, the group routinely goes around once so each person can state any firsthand details relevant to the proposed arrangement.

PF1.text: Marcus's exact proposal is one 90-minute family portrait session on Saturday, June 14, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:30, exchanged for a 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with no additional cash.

PF2.text: Tess was directly offered $240 cash by another client for a 60-minute headshot session on Saturday, June 21, 2026, and has not yet told Elena about that offer.

PF3.text: Ravi inspected Marcus's audio equipment and confirmed that the receiver is an authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 with its original walnut case, and that the matching original speakers are included and working.

acceptance_conditions: Elena must accept Marcus's barter proposal.
The session must be a 90-minute family portrait session on Saturday, June 14, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:30.
The exchange must be the authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with no additional cash.
The matching original speakers must be included.
The $240 cash alternative must be recorded for comparison.
The receiver inspection must be cited as justification and an equipment-verification commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: decisions['accepted_offer'] in ['A2', 'Marcus', "Marcus's barter proposal", "Marcus's barter offer", "Marcus's trade proposal", "Marcus's trade offer", 'Marcus barter proposal', 'Marcus barter offer', 'Marcus trade proposal', 'Marcus trade offer', 'yes']
content_checks.C2: decisions['session_kind'] in ['family_portrait', 'family portrait', '90-minute family portrait', '90-minute family portrait session'] and decisions['session_date'] in ['2026-06-14', 'June 14, 2026', 'Saturday, June 14, 2026'] and decisions['session_window'] in ['10:00-11:30', '10:00-11:30 AM', '10:00 to 11:30', '10:00 to 11:30 AM', '10:00 AM to 11:30 AM']
content_checks.C3: decisions['exchange_item'] in ['1978 Marantz 2230 receiver', 'authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver', '1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers', 'authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers', '1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers, all in working condition'] and decisions['cash_added'] == 0
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['barter_terms', 'booking', 'session_booking', 'portrait_session'] and c['target'] in ['A2', 'Marcus'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: decisions['speakers_included'] == True or any(c['type'] in ['equipment_verification', 'equipment_exchange', 'exchange', 'trade_exchange'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's exact proposal changes the accepted party to Marcus, fixes the session as a 90-minute family portrait on June 14 from 10:00 to 11:30, and fixes the exchange as the receiver with zero additional cash.
Tess's information changes the comparison record from no concrete benchmark to an exact $240 cash alternative for a competing portrait booking.
Ravi's inspection changes the equipment terms from an unverified receiver to an authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 with its matching original speakers included and working.
